description: Two-channel universal analog input module (thermocouple, Pt100, mV, V, mA) with Modbus RTU over RS485: channel values, status flags, input configuration, indication limits and tags

sources.title: DigiRail-2A Módulo de Entradas Analógicas Universais - Manual de Comunicação

notes: Factory defaults: address 247, 1200 bit/s, even parity, 1 stop bit. Pressing the RCom button puts the module in diagnostic mode for one minute with address 246, 1200 bit/s, even parity.
Functions 03 (read holding registers), 04 (read input registers) and 06 (write single register). The manual lists no write-multiple function, so each setting is written on its own.
The channel values are also in input registers 0-1 (percent) and 5-6 (engineering unit); this map reads the same values from the holding registers, which hold the configuration too.
Novus recommends configuring the module with its DigiConfig software; the configuration registers are listed so the settings can be checked.
The manual does not say how many decimal places the engineering-unit values have: they follow the module's configuration (the indication limits for linear inputs).
The manual does not give the character order of the tags; this map assumes the first character is in the high byte.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.
